g.text: Inclusion: authors on 2+ corpus items with 3+ co-author links (34 of 677 authors in the corpus). Node size and the number in the legend are that author's item count;

text.style: fill: #71717a; font: 7.9px 'IBM Plex Sans', 'system-ui', 'Arial', sans-serif

g.text: edge width is joint items. Position carries no meaning beyond connectivity. Names are surname + first initial: the journal database does not disambiguate authors, so same-initial namesakes merge.
